description: Terracotta Jali Tiles 002 are a square-grid clay jali from Pak Clay, the perforated kind of screen used for boundary walls, garden walls and outdoor seating areas. The open pattern lets air and filtered light pass while softening views from outside. Fired clay gives a warm terracotta colour that suits brick, plaster and greenery, and it usually weathers without repainting. Check the piece size and fixing method with your mason before ordering, and buy extra from one batch. Ask for a free sample on WhatsApp and send your wall length and city for a written quote.
